title: Dragon Vein First Appears
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji gripped the letter, the imperial envoy's words exploded like thunder in his ears—"Your father is still alive."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was still immersed in the weight of that farewell, a completely black crow silently landed on the windowsill, holding a yellowed letter in its beak—the mark of the Demonic Holy Sect. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply; deep within that crow's eyes seemed to flow an eerie light, as if silently conveying a summoning from the abyss. He reached out to take the letter, and the moment his fingertips touched the paper, a familiar demonic aura spread along his meridians—that was Ye Qing's unique spiritual imprint. The letter contained only a few brief words: "Court intervenes, leave Tianqing swiftly." The ink was still wet, yet between the lines ran an unprecedented urgency.

dialogue.content: The court... arrived faster than I anticipated.

text.content: Before his words even finished, the sky outside Tianqing Sect suddenly darkened. A brilliant golden pillar of light pierced through from the horizon, accompanied by rumbling pressure, as if countless bolts of thunder rolled within the clouds. Chen Ji's gaze slightly condensed—that pressure's intensity was clearly perceptible even from miles away—this was the unique aura of the court's dragon vein, by no means comparable to ordinary sects. The mountain gate's protective great formation emitted a sharp alarm, golden lights flowing across its surface, showing the formation masters were desperately operating the defenses.

dialogue.content: "The court's celestial envoy arrives at Tianqing Sect, why do you not all hastily welcome!" A voice of incomparable authority pierced through layers of clouds, echoing above the entire Tianqing Sect. The domineering air within that voice caused many outer disciples to kneel on the spot, and even inner disciples' faces turned pale—only Chen Ji remained with hands clasped behind his back by the window, eyes flickering with profound light.

text.content: Where the golden pillar dissipated, a figure in dragon-patterned brocade robes gradually manifested. The arrival was approximately forty years old, with an elegant yet iron-willed countenance, lips carrying a hint of nonchalant smile, as if all things in heaven and earth were beneath his notice. Behind him followed twelve guards in dark armor, each one's aura not below the Golden Core stage. Beside him stood an elderly scholar in white robes, with white hair and beard, yet eyes as sharp as a hawk's. When Chen Ji met those eyes, he felt a strange sense of familiarity.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Come out! Su Qingyao's voice came from outside the door, carrying undisguised anxiety. She wore a light blue dress today, originally coming to discuss demonic path movements with Chen Ji, yet never expected to encounter such a world-shaking event. She strode into the room and grabbed Chen Ji's wrist, attempting to pull him outside: "The court people specifically requested to see you—it's definitely nothing good, we must first devise a strategy!"

choice.prompt: The court envoy specifically requested to see you, this "waste"—Su Qingyao is extremely anxious. How should you respond now?

choices.text: Accept the invitation boldly, continue playing the pig
choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, face the court envoy with the most humble posture, conceal all brilliance.
choices.visible_cost: May be humiliated on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Court relaxes vigilance, gains space for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely reveal the existence of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji gently patted the back of Su Qingyao's hand, the corner of his lips curving into a nonchalant arc: "Senior Su, please don't worry. Since the distinguished court guests have invited me, if this废物 doesn't go, wouldn't that make Tianqing Sect appear discourteous?" His tone was light and casual, as if the person he was about to face wasn't a court angel but merely an ordinary visitor. Su Qingyao stared at him blankly; that pair of eyes usually full of suspicion now flickered with complex emotions—she always felt this young man was hiding some unknown secret.

choices.description: Without waiting for the envoy to come to you, proactively appear and reveal your leverage, disrupting the opponent's rhythm.
choices.visible_reward: Grasp initiative in dialogue, throw the court envoy into a passive position
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from higher levels in the court

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, slowly walking toward the door, his back to Su Qingyao: "Senior sister, what do you think—should a lamb awaiting slaughter wait for the butcher to arrive, or should it first check whether he carries a blade?" Su Qingyao's pupils slightly contracted; this was the first time she saw in this废物 junior's eyes something that made her heart tremble—that was the composure and calculation of one who controls everything.

choices.description: Make no move, first let the court envoy clash with sect higher-ups, gather intelligence before deciding.
choices.visible_reward: Court and sect contradictions intensify, reap the渔翁 benefit
choices.risk_hint: May be regarded as disrespectful by the Imperial Court

text.content: Chen Ji settled back by the window, gazing through the lattice at the distant golden pillar of light: 'Senior Sister, the Imperial envoys have traveled thousands of miles, yet they specifically requested to see the most insignificant servant disciple of Tianqing Sect—don't you find that suspicious?' Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, then fell into contemplation. Chen Ji continued: 'Let them have a taste of our Sect Master first. I'd like to see how deep the Imperial waters run.'

However, Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation suddenly began to tremble violently, with a massive crack appearing on the light barrier. A white-robed elder behind the Imperial envoy stepped forward, holding a jade seal that radiated a cold, eerie glow—the Imperial Dragon Vein Seal, a supreme treasure specifically designed to suppress sect formations. The protective mountain formation, which Tianqing Sect relied on for survival, crumbled like paper before this seal, with specks of golden light falling like snowflakes.

dialogue.content: 'The Dragon Vein Seal... they actually brought this thing!' Su Qingyao's face instantly turned deathly pale. She tightly gripped Chen Ji's wrist, her knuckles whitening from the force: 'Chen Ji, this is the supreme treasure the Imperial Court uses to suppress the Ten Great Sects. Once deployed, it carries the threat of annihilation. They're determined to target you this time!'

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the slowly healing crack, yet there was not a trace of panic in his eyes. He gently patted Su Qingyao's hand and spoke in a low, calm voice: 'Senior Sister, there's no need to panic. If the Imperial Court truly wanted to destroy the sect, they wouldn't have brought only twelve guards and one Dragon Vein Seal. They came in grand fashion, but what they seek is not war, but—' His gaze pierced through the heavy clouds, meeting the white-robed elder's eyes across the distance: 'An answer.'

dialogue.content: 'Where is Chen Ji? The Imperial Celestial Messenger has questions.' Just then, Ling Yuan's voice drifted down from the mountaintop, carrying an unnoticeable chill. Chen Ji looked toward the peak, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips—the old fox thinks passing the ball to me will keep him out of trouble? He straightened his clothes, casting one final glance at Su Qingyao: 'Senior Sister, I'll be back shortly. Whatever happens, do not interfere.'

text.content: When Chen Ji stepped into the sect's main hall, every gaze instantly focused on him. Ling Yuan sat at the main seat, his face like still water; the Imperial envoy stood in the hall's center, hands clasped behind his back, those deep eyes seeming to see through all illusions; and the white-robed elder stood beside the envoy, his burning gaze fixed on Chen Ji, as if examining a treasure that had been lost and found again. Chen Ji bowed without arrogance or humility, his voice calm as water: 'Servant disciple Chen Ji, greets the Celestial Messenger.'

dialogue.content: 'So you're Chen Ji?' The Imperial envoy studied this extraordinarily ordinary young man before him, his brow slightly furrowing: 'Just as the intelligence indicated—utterly insignificant, even his cultivation talent is the worst Five Elements Spirit Root. Such a person actually made the Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing personally write a warning—how interesting.' His gaze shifted to the white-robed elder: 'Mr. Bai, are you certain it's him?'

text.content: The white-robed elder didn't answer immediately. Instead, he slowly walked toward Chen Ji. His steps seemed leisurely, yet each one landed on some peculiar rhythm, causing Chen Ji to feel unprecedented pressure. When the two were less than three feet apart, the elder suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a trace of trembling: 'Your brows, your features, your contours... are exactly like those of my old friend who disappeared years ago, carved from the same mold.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart lurched violently, yet his expression remained unmoved: 'Elder must be mistaken? This junior is merely an orphan who grew up in Tianqing Sect and has never seen my parents.' The white-robed elder stared into his eyes, then suddenly burst into laughter, though the sound carried hints of bitterness: 'So you've never seen them! Do you know that your father was once the Imperial Court's most outstanding secret agent, codename 'Azure Dragon', specializing in probing sect secrets? And the year he disappeared was precisely when he was investigating something that could overturn the entire cultivation world—' He paused, his gaze like a blade stabbing toward Chen Ji: 'The Tianji Record!'

choice.prompt: The Imperial envoy publicly reveals your father's identity and claims to possess secrets about the Tianji Record. How should you respond at this moment?

choices.description: Continue playing the role of an ignorant waste, showing complete ignorance about the existence of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen through by the elder's lies
choices.visible_reward: The Imperial Court cannot confirm the charges, leaving room for escape
choices.risk_hint: The elder clearly holds key evidence

dialogue.content: Chen Ji wore a dazed expression: 'Tianji Record? This junior has never even heard this name, let alone know what it is. If His Excellency the Celestial Messenger suspects this junior of harboring a secret treasure, you may search me on the spot.' With that, he spread his arms open, assuming a posture of being at someone's mercy. The Imperial envoy's brow furrowed, but a trace of imperceptible appreciation flashed in the white-robed elder's eyes—this young man's temperament is exactly like his father's in his prime.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, seize the initiative
choices.description: Acknowledge some facts, but steer the topic toward the Imperial Court's true purpose, taking control of negotiations.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal some understanding of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Put the Imperial envoy on the defensive, displaying extraordinary courage
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into the Imperial Court's trap

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp. He stared directly into the white-robed elder's eyes, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable force: 'Elder speaks well. Since the Imperial Court is so set on obtaining the Tianji Record, may I ask Your Excellency the Celestial Messenger—just what exactly do you want? This legendary treasure, or me?' The Imperial envoy's pupils slightly contracted, yet the white-robed elder clapped his hands in laughter: 'Good! Good! Good! Truly Chen family bloodline—this composure under pressure surpasses even your father in his day!'

choices.text: Cast out bait, risk one's life
choices.description: Reveal partial information about the Tianji Record, conduct an exchange of interests with the Imperial Court, in exchange for greater leverage.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the true power of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain imperial dynasty resource support while maintaining independence
choices.risk_hint: The imperial dynasty may become increasingly demanding

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh, a hint of nonchalant cynicism in that smile: 'Since the old gentleman has been so frank, then this junior might as well tell the Angel Lord—the Tianji Record is indeed in my possession, but its price is far beyond what ordinary people can bear. If the Angel Lord wishes to obtain it, you'd better bring something truly valuable to exchange.' At these words, everyone in the hall was shocked. Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with greed, while the white-robed elder's smile deepened: 'You are more skilled at bargaining than your father. Speak, what do you want?'

text.content: Just as the atmosphere fell into a delicate stalemate, the imperial dynasty envoy suddenly spoke. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every person present: 'Mo Xiansheng's mission is to investigate the Tianji Record's whereabouts, but that is not the purpose of this official's visit.' His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying a meaningful scrutiny: 'This official has come by His Majesty's personal decree to confirm something—the truth about the Chen family's bloodbath all those years ago.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze slightly congealed. A bloodbath? His heart surged with tumultuous waves, but his expression remained unruffled: 'The Angel Lord mentions a bloodbath, but what exactly are you referring to?' The imperial dynasty envoy did not answer, but instead took a Jade Slip from his sleeve and gently tossed it toward Chen Ji. The Jade Slip traced a graceful arc through the air, landing steadily in Chen Ji's palm. He looked down, his pupils constricting sharply—the Jade Slip was inscribed with four large characters: 'Qinglong Testament Letter.'

text.content: This Jade Slip was entrusted by your father to be returned to the imperial dynasty before his death. The imperial dynasty envoy's voice echoed in the silent great hall: 'The Jade Slip not only contains his investigation findings over these years, but also leaves behind a secret that shocked even His Majesty—the Tianji Record is not merely a prophetic treasure; its true purpose is to serve as the key to opening a certain Ancient Forbidden Land. And within that forbidden land, it is said that something is sealed away—one capable of shaking the order of heaven itself.'

dialogue.content: The fingers holding the Jade Slip turned slightly white. Chen Ji's mind raced through various possibilities—his father? An imperial dynasty secret agent? The true secret of the Tianji Record? This information constantly collided, intertwined, and reorganized with the truths he already knew, yet could never piece together a complete picture. Just then, a虚弱 yet familiar spiritual sense fluctuation suddenly emerged from within the Jade Slip—a hoarse and weary voice: 'Ji'er, if you can hear these words, it means your father is no longer among the living. But you must remember—'

At this critical moment, the imperial dynasty envoy suddenly waved his hand, a golden light enveloping the Jade Slip, and the spiritual sense fluctuation ceased abruptly. He looked at Chen Ji, a flicker of apology crossing his eyes: 'Qinglong elder's farewell words are too long; this official can tell you slowly. But before that, there is one thing you must know first—' His voice suddenly dropped low, each word articulated deliberately: 'Your father is not dead. He has been imprisoned in the deepest depths of the imperial dynasty's Heavenly Prison, for a full eighteen years.'

text.content: This sentence struck like a thunderbolt, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. His breathing abruptly hastened, his hands unconsciously clenching into fists. Eighteen years... that was the entire time it took for him to grow from an infant to a youth. His father was in the imperial dynasty's Heavenly Prison, while he spent a full eighteen years as a废物 in the Tianqing Sect, enduring everyone's mockery and bullying, yet never knowing this truth! A surge of overwhelming hatred and grief gushed forth from his chest, nearly breaking through the dam of his reason.

But Chen Ji was ultimately Chen Ji. He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing that almost uncontrollable emotion back into the depths of his heart. When he opened his eyes again, those two eyes had already restored their usual calmness and profundity, as if the momentary loss of composure had never occurred. He looked at the imperial dynasty envoy, his voice low and composed: 'The Angel Lord specially told me these things, surely not just for old times' sake? What the imperial dynasty wants, speak directly.' The imperial dynasty envoy's lips slightly curved upward, revealing an appreciative smile: 'Speaking with a smart person is refreshing. His Majesty wants you to do three things—first, hand over the Tianji Record; second, rescue your father; third, become the imperial dynasty's spokesperson in the cultivation world. In return, the imperial dynasty can help you unify the three major sects, or even—help you find your sister who disappeared many years ago.'

The moment the word 'sister' reached his ears, Chen Ji's heart pounded violently once again. Chen Nian—his亲妹妹 who was taken away by the Holy Sect, becoming a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' the imperial dynasty actually knew her whereabouts? He stared fixedly at the imperial dynasty envoy's eyes, trying to discern truth from falsehood. The envoy seemed to see through his thoughts, nodding lightly: 'Your sister Chen Nian is indeed still alive, and she is under the imperial dynasty's control. The Holy Sect thought they were acting secretly without anyone knowing, but they did not realize that every move they made was under the imperial dynasty's surveillance.'

dialogue.content: Just then, Su Qingyao, who had been silently observing, suddenly spoke. Her voice was cold as ice, carrying an undisguised hostility: 'The Angel Lord's conditions sound enticing, but this junior ventures to ask—if Chen Ji accepts the imperial dynasty's conditions, does he still have a way out in the Tianqing Sect, in the cultivation world? Will the three major sects let him go? Will the Demonic Path let him go? Even the Heavenly Eye—' Her words abruptly stopped, as if realizing she had said something wrong, and quickly fell silent. The imperial dynasty envoy's gaze lingered on her for a moment, smiling thoughtfully: 'Su family's girl, you are indeed more courageous than your timid and cowardly sect master.'

text.content: Ling Yuan's face turned as dark as if it were about to drip water. He had originally wanted to use the imperial dynasty's hand to eliminate Chen Ji, but he hadn't expected Su Qingyao to suddenly make trouble, nor had he expected the imperial dynasty envoy to be so 'courteous' toward Chen Ji. He coughed dryly, attempting to regain the initiative: 'Angel Lord, matters concerning our sect should be handled by our sect, why bother troubling the imperial dynasty—' The imperial dynasty envoy simply glanced at him indifferently, the contempt in that gaze almost undisguised: 'Sect Master Ling, this official is speaking with Chen Ji; you had better shut up.'

Ling Yuan's face flushed to a dark purple, yet he dared not offer even a hint of rebuttal. Although he was the Tianqing Sect Master, before the imperial dynasty's Dragon Vein Seal, the entire Tianqing Sect was nothing more than an ant-like existence. He could only suppress the burning fury in his heart, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying additional bone-deep resentment—how could this废物 cause the imperial dynasty envoy to personally back him up? What gives him the right!

In the great hall, the atmosphere had thickened to the extreme. Chen Ji stood in place, but his mind was racing at lightning speed. The imperial dynasty's conditions seemed enticing, yet every step was a lethal trap—handing over the Tianji Record meant handing over his life, rescuing his father required deep penetration into the imperial dynasty's heartland, and becoming the imperial dynasty's spokesperson would make him a target for all. But the news about his sister... that was Chen Nian, his亲妹妹, even if the path ahead was filled withblades and fire, he had to go.

choice.prompt: Imperial dynasty envoy offers enticing conditions: hand over Tianji Record, rescue father, become imperial dynasty spokesperson, in exchange for imperial dynasty support and clues about sister. At this moment, how do you decide?

choices.description: Neither explicitly accept nor reject, first use imperial dynasty's resources to gather intelligence, silently accumulate strength.
choices.visible_cost: May be exposed by imperial dynasty, offend both sides
choices.visible_reward: Stall for time, simultaneously obtain intelligence about father and sister
choices.risk_hint: Imperial dynasty envoy is deeply scheming, not easily fooled

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly raised his head, a meaningful smile appearing on his face: 'The Angel Lord's conditions, Chen Ji has heard and understood. However, this matter is of great significance; permit me to consider for a few days before giving an answer. But during this period—' His gaze swept across the imperial dynasty envoy, the white-robed elder, finally landing on Su Qingyao: 'I would like to make a small transaction with the Angel Lord first. I wonder if the imperial dynasty could first let me see the Jade Slip left by my father? After all, I must verify the authenticity of the information, right?' The imperial dynasty envoy's eyes flickered with appreciation: 'You are indeed cautious. This point, you are exactly like your father in his prime.'

choices.description: Directly reject imperial dynasty's conditions, make clear never to become a chess piece for any faction.
choices.visible_cost: Losing traces of his father and sister
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and earn reputation in the cultivation world
choices.risk_hint: The Imperial Court might turn hostile on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, a smile carrying a hint of resolve and pride: "Your Grace's kindness, Chen Ji appreciates. But in this world, there has never been a free lunch. Everything the Imperial Court gives me will become a chain around my neck in the future." He tossed the jade slip back to the envoy: "My father's matter, I will investigate myself; my sister's matter, I will rescue myself. As for the Tianji Record——" His gaze suddenly turned sharp: "This is my own thing, and no one shall take it!" The entire hall was shocked, even a flicker of surprise crossing the Imperial Court envoy's eyes. This废物young man actually dared to refuse the Imperial Court to its face?

choices.text: Working behind the scenes with ulterior motives
choices.description: Pretending to agree to some conditions while secretly making arrangements, turning the Imperial Court into one of his own pieces as well
choices.visible_cost: May be constrained by others in the short term
choices.visible_reward: Gain Imperial Court resource support while keeping the core secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by the Imperial Court, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before finally speaking slowly: "Your Grace's conditions, Chen Ji can consider. But I have one condition——I must see my father first." A playful glint flashed in the Imperial Court envoy's eyes: "You're quite frank. Very well, this official can arrange it. But before that, you must first let this official confirm one thing——" His voice suddenly turned ice-cold: "What exactly is the true ability of the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's heart sank sharply, but he quickly steadied himself, revealing a bitter smile: "Your Grace wishes to know? Then this junior might as well be frank——the Tianji Record can indeed foresee the future, but each use consumes Heavenly Fate. And my Heavenly Fate is nearly depleted." He spoke the truth, only hiding the more crucial part. The Imperial Court envoy nodded thoughtfully: "Interesting."

Just as the atmosphere reached a breaking point, a thunderous roar suddenly echoed across the Tianqing Sect. A black pillar of light tore through the eastern sky, accompanied by rolling demonic energy, shrouding the entire Tianqing Sect in shadow. The Imperial Court envoy's expression changed drastically: "The Holy Sect of the Demonic Path! How dare they——" Before he could finish, a enchanting figure had already emerged from the black mist—Ye Qing. Her face carried rare gravity as her gaze swept between the Imperial Court envoy and Chen Ji, finally fixing on Chen Ji: "Chen Ji, I've come to take you. The Imperial Court is merely the Dragon's Vein appearing for the first time; the true storm is still ahead."

Three major forces gathered at the Tianqing Sect—the Imperial Court, the Sect, and the Demonic Path. Three completely different auras collided violently in the air. Chen Ji stood at the storm's center, watching this scene, yet an inexplicable calm welled up in his heart. From the moment he transmigrated to this world, he had been constantly scheming and calculating, all for this moment—when all the pieces came to the stage, he could finally begin the true game.

Ye Qing hovered in mid-air, demonic mist swirling around her,衬得如同深渊中走出的女王. Her gaze swept over the Imperial Court envoy with undisguised mockery: "The Dragon's Vein Seal? The Imperial Court's foundation is indeed profound. I only wonder how long this jade seal can withstand the Holy Sect's forbidden arts?" The Imperial Court envoy's expression darkened, but he didn't immediately respond. Upon seeing this, Ye Qing's lips curved slightly upward as she turned to look at Chen Ji: "Chen Ji, my proposal remains valid. As long as you come with me, the Holy Sect can help you rescue your father, find your sister, and simultaneously——" Her voice lowered: "Help you uncover the true secret of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji watched Ye Qing quietly—this former Saintess of the Demonic Path, now partner. The urgency in her eyes was clear to him—it wasn't merely an exchange of interests, but carried some indescribable emotion within. He sighed lightly and spoke: "Ye Qing, I appreciate your kindness. But now is not the time to make a choice——" His gaze turned to the Imperial Court envoy: "Your Grace said you wanted me to consider for a few days, so Chen Ji will give you an answer. In three days, I will personally go to the Imperial Capital to discuss matters with His Majesty face to face." A hint of satisfaction flashed in the Imperial Court envoy's eyes: "Very well, this official will await you in the Imperial Capital."

text.content: Chen Ji's words left everyone present stunned. He had chosen neither the Imperial Court nor the Demonic Path, but instead chose a third path—personally going to the Imperial Capital to negotiate with the Emperor face to face. This decision was bold to the extreme, yet also clever to the extreme. Because no matter what choice he made, he would offend the other two parties; by proactively going to the Imperial Capital, he gave the Imperial Court face while buying himself buffer time, and furthermore demonstrated to the Demonic Path a stance of "I am not an ungrateful person." Ye Qing glanced at him deeply, a meaningful smile curling her lips: "Very well, I'll wait for you." With that, her figure merged back into the black mist and vanished into the eastern horizon. Seeing this, the Imperial Court envoy said no more, simply casting a profound look at Chen Ji before transforming into golden light with the white-robed elder and guards, departing.

When all the dust settled, only Chen Ji, Su Qingyao, and Ling Yuan remained in the Tianqing Sect's main hall. Ling Yuan's face阴沉, wordlessly sweeping his sleeves and leaving—his face had been completely lost today, and his hatred for Chen Ji had deepened. Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji, her eyes full of complex emotions: "Are you really going to the Imperial Capital? That place is a dragon's pool and tiger's den—one misstep means utter destruction." Chen Ji turned around, looking at this woman who had always tried to uncover his secrets yet repeatedly helped him, his lips curving slightly upward: "Su Senior Sister, why did you help me today?" Su Qingyao was stunned, then turned her head away: "I just didn't want to see that old fox Ling Yuan have his way." Chen Ji laughed lightly, not exposing her excuse.

Night fell. Chen Ji stood alone before the window, the jade slip inscribed with "Qinglong's Testament Letter" in his hand. Moonlight fell across his face, reflecting a pair of deep and complex eyes. His father's truth, his sister's whereabouts, the secret of the Tianji Record, the Imperial Court's ambition—all the clues intertwined, collided, and reorganized in his mind. He gently stroked the patterns on the jade slip's surface, as if touching那段被尘封的过往. At this moment, an ancient voice resonated in his mind—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice: "Chen Ji, you did well. But the road ahead will be far more difficult than you imagine. Remember——the true secret of the Tianji Record is far more terrifying than you can imagine."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting Mo Xiansheng's words reverberate in his mind. The true secret of the Tianji Record? An ability more terrifying than foreseeing the future? He suddenly thought of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—that terrifying existence that had been looming over him since Volume Eight. If the Tianji Record was merely one of the pieces set up by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, then what value did his eighteen years of scheming hold before that transcendent gaze? He took a deep breath, pressing these wandering thoughts back down into his heart. Three days later, the Imperial Capital journey was imminent. Whether ahead lay dragon's pools and tiger's dens or hills of swords and seas of flames, he had to walk this path. Because there awaited not only his father's truth and his sister's whereabouts, but also——the key to unraveling the Tianji Record's true secret.
Just as Chen Ji gripped the letter, the Imperial Court envoy's words thundered in his ears like a sudden explosion——"Your father is still alive to this day."
